artworks.title: Leopold Dick
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 22.7 x 15.7 cm (8 15/16 x 6 3/16 in.) (cut to platemark)
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the gift of Dewayne and Faith Perry
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a person depicted from the waist up. The person is positioned in a slightly turned stance, with their head facing forward. The facial features include prominent eyes, a broad nose, and a full beard. The hair is curly and falls to the side of the face, emerging from under a large fabric hat. The clothing is ornate and detailed, featuring a richly textured and patterned fabric with elaborate designs on the sleeves and body. The person is holding a scroll in their right hand. Surrounding the individual is a text in a classical style, and the background is plain.

artworks.title: La Drague Dieppe (A Dredger in Dieppe Harbor by Moonlight)
artworks.medium: color etching and aquatint in blue and black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Given in the Memory of Martin Atlas by his Friends
artworks.description: The image shows a waterfront view at dusk or dawn, overlooking the water towards the pier and city. The horizon is low in the image, just below the line of the pier and silhouetted cranes. The artwork style appears to use etching techniques with sharp lines and deep shadows. The color palette consists of dark tones, primarily blues and grays. The water reflects the dim light of a hidden or setting sun. There is a close structure resembling a dredger with a large wheel.

artworks.title: Christ as Man of Sorrows
artworks.artist: Antoine Coypel, finished in engraving by Charles Simonneau
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of a man's body. His head is tilted back, looking upwards with partially closed eyes. He has a beard, mustache, long wavy hair falling past his shoulders, and a crown of thorns on his head. The man wears a loose garment, crosses his hands over his chest, and holds a staff or rod. He has a thick rope around his neck and wrist. The background is dark, and there is a decorative label with text and a crest with a serpent emblem at the bottom.

artworks.title: Oaks near a Pond
artworks.medium: etching on chine collé on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with hills, trees, a path, and water. The view is from a slightly elevated perspective, allowing a broad view of the terrain. The horizon is low in the image with rolling hills, a line of trees in the distance, and a dense cluster of trees on the right. A path winds through the grass, and there are fine, delicate lines showing details like tree textures and water ripples. The color palette is monochromatic, with varying shades of grey, emphasizing details and contrasts.

artworks.title: Le Charlemagne (forêt de fontainebleau)
artworks.description: The image depicts a dense forest with a winding path surrounded by tall trees. The horizon is obscured by foliage, and there is a monochrome color scheme focused on black, gray, and white tones. The brushstrokes detail tree bark, leaves, and forest floor textures. Light filters through the canopy, creating patterns of light and shadow on the ground and tree trunks.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.description: The image features four monochromatic drawings of a man's head and shoulders in different angles: front, two sides, and three-quarter. The man has a round face, thick wavy hair with sideburns, and wears circular glasses. He is dressed in a high-collared coat over a cravat. There are no visible accessories. The background is plain, highlighting the detailed depictions of the man. The artwork is signed "L. Boilly 1833."

artworks.title: Frontispiece
artworks.description: The image shows a large bird with wide wings spread upwards and a hanging deer with its head facing downwards on the left side. The color palette is monochrome black and white. To the left, the deer hangs from a tree branch alongside the bird. To the right, two smaller birds are perched on a ledge next to a piece of paper with written text. The background includes architectural elements and foliage.

artworks.title: A Fox Attacked by Dogs
artworks.description: The image is an etching of dogs in a detailed landscape. The pack of dogs is engaged in various activities, with two dogs focused on something on the ground. The perspective is slightly elevated, showing the animals and the surrounding environment. The horizon is depicted higher up, where it meets a group of trees. The trees are intricately detailed, with branches and leaves etched realistically. The artwork uses monochromatic tones, mainly grays, to create depth and texture. Cross-hatching and stippling techniques are used to enhance the fur, foliage, and ground textures. The sky shows lightly etched clouds, directing attention to the dogs and the immediate landscape.

artworks.title: A Wolf Attacked by Dogs
artworks.description: The image shows a pack of dogs attacking a wolf. Several dogs are overpowering the wolf, surrounded by trees and rocks. The background includes foliage, a tree, and a sky with shaded clouds. Below the scene is an inscription in French. The composition is detailed, depicting dynamic movement and interaction between the animals.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.description: This image shows a portrait of a person in three-quarter profile facing left. They have pointed nose, defined jawline, and a contemplative expression. The person has light-colored, shoulder-length hair parted in the middle, and is wearing a high-collared shirt with a cravat under an open coat. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Interno di un Carcere (Interior of a Prison)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a perspective from a low angle of a large architectural space resembling a dungeon or prison interior. The scene is filled with intricate stonework, stairs leading deeper into the structure, looming arches, and various architectural structures. There are shadows, ropes, and chains throughout, creating a sense of complexity and weight. The painting uses detailed brushstrokes to depict stone textures and play with light and shadow. The color palette consists of sepia tones, emphasizing structural details and light interplay. In the background, a staircase leads to additional chambers, with shafts of light penetrating the space from above, highlighting architectural elements.

artworks.title: Vidi, quod aperuisset agnus... (The Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse)
artworks.description: The image shows four horsemen in a dramatic composition. The drawing depicts four muscular figures riding horses, each with unique attributes. The central figure holds a bow, with flowing hair. Another figure holds scales, symbolizing balance or judgment. A third figure is hunched over a horse in the foreground, while a fourth figure stands holding a sword in the background, looking towards a distant shore. The scene conveys movement through the posture of the figures and horses. Created with a monochrome palette, the drawing utilizes strong contrast and delicate linework to show depth and texture, resulting in a intense depiction.

artworks.title: Oriental with a Plumed Hat, Looking Right
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Jimmy and Jessica Younger, Houston
artworks.description: The image displays an illustration of a man's upper body. He is slightly turned to the right, with his head angled left. The man has a mustache, beard, deep-set eyes, and expressive facial features. His headwear features large feathers and his clothing appears loose and voluminous, hinting at an earlier historical period. He holds an ornate head accessory. The background consists of crosshatching lines. The image is signed by the artist and dated "1778" at the bottom.

artworks.title: Emperor Charles V
artworks.medium: etching (iron) with open biting and unique contemporary hand-coloring in green, red, yellow, pink and brown
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Ladislaus and Beatrix von Hoffmann
artworks.description: The image shows a man in profile view with distinct facial features, a light brown, medium-length hair, and wearing a dark flat cap and a patterned robe. The background features a green pattern of scrolls and floral designs. Below the portrait is a text panel in bold, serif typeface.

artworks.title: Oriental with a Turban, Three-Quarter View
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Jimmy and Jessica Younger, Houston
artworks.description: The image depicts a bust-length view of a person in a three-quarter perspective, focusing on their upper torso and head. The person is positioned slightly to the side, looking upwards with a subtle smile. They have prominent eyes, a mustache, and slightly wavy hair peeking out from under their headwear. The mid-length hair adds texture to the portrait. They wear a large, intricately wrapped turban with feathers on top. The clothing consists of draped fabric, suggesting a robe or cloak, with a fabric tie at the neck. The background has a simple, textured pattern. The artwork emphasizes line work and detail, showcasing the person's character and attire.

artworks.title: Oriental with a Fur Hat, Looking Left
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Jimmy and Jessica Younger, Houston
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person in a profile view facing left. The person has an elongated face with prominent facial features. They wear an elaborate headpiece, possibly a turban or hat, with a prominent plume or fur-like texture rising. The clothing is loose-fitting, suggesting a robe or cloak. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background is textured with cross-hatched lines. A signature and the year "1775" are in the corner of the image.

artworks.title: Oriental with a Soft Hat in Profile, Looking Left
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Jimmy and Jessica Younger, Houston
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a person's side profile from the chest up. The individual is facing left, with their head turned slightly to the side. The person has a prominent nose, full beard, and a slight frown. They are wearing a voluminous headwrap that covers their hair and drapes over their shoulders. The clothing has tassels hanging down, adding texture and detail. The background has cross-hatching lines for texture, framing the figure. The bottom of the image includes text that reads "Paul Haubenstricker f: 1775."

artworks.title: Shepherds with Their Herd Fording a Stream
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from an elevated perspective. The horizon line is high, showing the terrain beyond, including hills and a distant structure. The brushstrokes are detailed, with dense clusters of lines creating textures in the foliage and landscape. The color palette is monochromatic, focusing on sepia and black. In the foreground, there is a stream or path with figures tending to cattle and sheep among trees.

artworks.title: Heinrich Julius von Goldbeck
artworks.medium: stipple etching printed in red on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Helmut H. and Petra Rumbler
artworks.description: The image shows a bust portrait of a man in an oval frame on the paper. The man's upper torso is visible, facing slightly to his left and looking at the viewer. He has distinct facial features, prominent cheeks, and a composed expression. His hair is styled back in an 18th-century fashion, with curls framing his face and a ribbon at the back. He wears a black jacket over a white shirt. The background is light beige with faint sketch markings on the left side, including a smaller drawing of a person and abstract forms.

artworks.title: William Tell Refusing to Honor Governor Gessler's Hat
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with grey and yellow wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rural scene with figures and thatched-roof buildings. The drawing shows a group of figures in historical attire standing and engaging in conversation in a rustic setting. In the foreground, a figure is seated, holding a long staff with a decorative top and appears deeply engaged in conversation, gesturing with their hands. Next to this figure, there is a large round object resembling a drum or wheel resting against a tree. Three other figures stand around the seated individual, also dressed in detailed period clothing and holding long tools or weapons. In the background, thatched-roof buildings suggest a rural village scene, with rolling hills and dense vegetation framing the settlement. The illustration is characterized by its elaborate detailing, expressive figures, and dynamic composition, conveying a narrative moment within a pastoral context.

artworks.title: A Seated Elderly Man Asleep
artworks.artist: Jean-Charles Francois, after Nicholas Henry Jeaurat de Bertry
artworks.medium: chalk manner, softground etching (and burnishing?) over etched texture (and lavis?)
artworks.description: The image depicts an elderly man from the waist up in a seated position. He is leaning forward, resting his left elbow on a surface while supporting his head with his hand. His eyes are closed, and he has a prominent beard and mustache, with thinning hair that recedes from his temples. The man is wearing a robe-like garment that covers his body, featuring a draped fabric that falls into soft folds. His other hand rests on his leg, open-palmed. The background is a plain, textured surface that gives depth to the image, with the edges of the garment and surface providing contrast against the backdrop. There are no visible objects or jewelry in the composition.

artworks.title: Souhaits Souhaits au Gui Le Siecle Neuf (Best Wishes for the New Century)
artworks.medium: gypsograph printed in red on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Given in Memory of Martin Atlas by his Friends
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a feminine figure holding a branch and scythe with a series of text around the outline. The figure appears elongated and ethereal, occupying the central focus of the image. Around the female figure is text that reads "SOVHAIT - SOVHAIT", "AV GU I", "LE SIECLE NEVF", and "1901". The drawing is executed in a style reminiscent of Art Nouveau, with flowing lines and a focus on the natural, dynamic movement of the form. The background consists of a subtle texture that contrasts with the smoothness of the white silhouette of the figure. The monochromatic use of red-brown hue adds warmth and a vintage quality to the artwork.

artworks.title: A Satyr Visiting a Peasant Family
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a domestic scene with various objects and furniture. The scene takes place in an interior setting with a large, arched window in the background. On the left, a figure sits with a child on their lap. Another child stands nearby. In the middle, a table is arranged with seated figures. To the right, a mythological creature is present. On the shelves and hooks in the background, household items and cooking utensils are visible. The drawing showcases intricate detailing and use of lines.
